name: Huang Lan Dao
source:
At that time, the whole world was in a state of localized hot wars, mostly during the Cold War period.  
A country's scientists discovered a toxic mimic "plant" resembling an orchid in deeper sea areas and used it to experiment and develop biochemical weapons.  
The story takes place on an island that was a popular tourist destination in earlier years, where researchers had long been stationed and bribed the government to prepare for large-scale biochemical experiments. After the experiments began, the entire island was cut off from communication with the outside world, and the sea was blocked, with a large number of gas bombs made from the toxic substance being dropped from the air...  
The protagonist is an "antidote" created by a "mysterious doctor," who awakens three years after this experiment.

Translate from https://www.gamemale.com/thread-94085-1-1.html
translation:
当时，全世界都处于局部热战状态，且大多处于冷战时期。
某国科学家在较深海域发现了一种类似兰花的有毒拟态“植物”，并用它来实验和研发生化武器。
故事发生在一座早年曾是热门旅游胜地的小岛上，研究人员长期驻扎在那里，贿赂政府，准备进行大规模的生化实验。实验开始后，整个岛屿与外界断绝了联系，大海也被封锁，大量有毒物质制成的毒气弹从空中落下……  
主角是一位“神秘医生”创造的“解药”，他在这次实验三年后苏醒。

翻译自https://www.gamemale.com/thread-94085-1-1.html
